content.raw:
The ear, nose and throat department treats adults and children with conditions of the ear, nose, sinuses, throat and the wider head and neck region. MedLuxLife coordinates access to ENT specialists at our partner hospital, covering surgery, rhinology, voice and swallowing disorders, and dizziness and balance problems. We organise your diagnostics, treatment dates and aftercare from start to finish.

Treatments and services

Adult ENT surgery

Procedures including endoscopic sinus surgery, tonsil and adenoid removal, septoplasty, turbinate reduction, ear tubes and tympanoplasty.

Paediatric ENT surgery

Surgery for children such as tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy, ear tubes, tympanoplasty, frenectomy and correction of protruding ears.

Head and neck surgery

Diagnosis and surgical treatment of benign and malignant tumours of the thyroid, neck, oral cavity, nasal passages, larynx and salivary glands.

Rhinology

Comprehensive nose and sinus assessment and treatment of sinusitis, nasal polyps, chronic congestion, allergies and sinonasal tumours, including endoscopic techniques.

Nasal breathing and nosebleeds

Options include radiofrequency turbinate reduction, septum correction, microdebrider polyp surgery and surgery for recurrent nosebleeds or persistent runny nose.

Snoring and sleep disorders

Diagnosis and treatment of snoring and sleep-related breathing problems.

Voice, speech and swallowing

A team of ENT surgeons, speech-language therapists, voice coaches, neurologists and gastroenterologists offers medical, surgical and behavioural care, including vocal aesthetics.

Hearing and tinnitus

Diagnosis and treatment of hearing loss and ringing in the ears.

Dizziness and balance

Clinical assessment, ENG/VNG and MRI testing, vestibular rehabilitation and balance training programmes for vertigo and balance disorders.

Facial and ear aesthetics

Rhinoplasty and other aesthetic nose procedures, plus ear aesthetics.

Procedures and conditions

  • Endoscopic sinus surgery
  • Tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy
  • Septoplasty
  • Concha (turbinate) reduction
  • Ear tubes
  • Tympanoplasty for eardrum perforations and chronic middle ear disease
  • Closed reduction of nasal fractures
  • Vertigo treatment
  • Tinnitus (ringing in the ears)
  • Hearing loss
  • Dysphagia (swallowing difficulties)
  • Voice disorders
  • Benign and malignant head and neck tumours
  • Aesthetic nose surgery and rhinoplasty
  • Ear aesthetics
  • Frenectomy (tongue-tie release)
  • Removal of foreign bodies from the ear and nose under anaesthesia
  • Correction of protruding ears
  • Allergic rhinitis
  • Acute and chronic sinusitis
  • Nasal polyps
  • Chronic nasal congestion
  • Nasal and sinus cavity tumours
  • Endoscopic sinonasal tumour surgery
  • Recurrent nosebleeds and persistent runny nose
  • Snoring and sleep disorders
  • Bowed vocal cords
  • Chronic hoarseness and sore throat
  • Laryngopharyngeal reflux
  • Laryngeal cancer
  • Spasmodic dysphonia
  • Vocal cord cysts
  • Vocal cord paralysis
  • Vocal abuse and overuse syndromes
  • Vocal nodules
  • Vocal polyps
  • Voice and swallowing disorders linked to Parkinson's disease and other neurological conditions
  • Labyrinthitis
  • Meniere's disease
  • Benign positional vertigo
  • ENG/VNG testing
  • Vestibular rehabilitation

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous hearing test (audiogram) results
  • Sinus CT or head and neck imaging, if available

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Otolaryngology (ENT) consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
